memo_delta.summary: The original Watchlist remains unresolved ahead of the October 23 results. The Q2 adjusted EBITDA forecast was falsified; cash-conversion and the matched leverage ratio still cannot be resolved from the reviewed release.
memo_delta.stage_one_comment: The original recommendation was Watchlist with no position. The shares are below the frozen reference, but the current evidence does not justify calling the whole thesis correct. The second-quarter adjusted EBITDA result beat the frozen consensus and falsified the forecast of no clear beat. That disconfirming result remains visible rather than being absorbed into the cautious headline. The two-print margin test still needs the October 23 results. Receivables and cash conversion are unresolved, and the reported increase in company-defined net debt does not establish a strict-basis trailing leverage ratio. Older Qatalum news is also not treated as a current operating update simply because it was crawled recently. Keep watching the next filing and reconcile these exact measures before considering a new position or raising confidence.
